summary_en: Onward Holdings will acquire all 5,000 shares of Sekimiki Group Co., Ltd., a women's apparel brand operator, achieving 100% ownership. The acquisition price is undisclosed due to confidentiality, but was determined based on third-party valuation. Post-acquisition, Sekimiki Group will be renamed Sekimiki Co., Ltd. and integrated to pursue synergies with existing businesses under the ONWARD VISION 2030 strategy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Shares (Complete Subsidiary Status)
translation_en_brief:
Onward Holdings has resolved to acquire all outstanding shares of Sekimiki Group Co., Ltd., a women's apparel company based in Fukuoka, to make it a wholly owned subsidiary. The target company operates fashion brands including Gready Brilliant and has posted consolidated sales of approximately 6.5 billion yen in its most recent fiscal year. The acquisition aligns with Onward's medium-to-long-term management plan ONWARD VISION 2030, which prioritizes diverse brand, product, and distribution strategies in the fashion domain. Following completion, Sekimiki Group will change its corporate name to Sekimiki Co., Ltd.

Onward will acquire 5,000 shares, representing 100% ownership. The company currently owns no shares in Sekimiki Group. The acquisition price is non-disclosed due to the target's individual shareholders and confidentiality agreements; however, it was determined based on third-party valuation of the company's equity value and negotiation with the sellers. The target has posted operating profit margins of 5.9% to 6.6% over the past three fiscal years ending August 2026, with net assets growing from 2.7 billion yen to 3.2 billion yen.

Onward plans to pursue synergies between Sekimiki Group and its existing businesses while supporting the target company's further growth under common ownership.
